name: Honjou Koyomi to Ushinawareta Nachlass
original_name: 本城恋読と失われた遺稿
source:
Showa, 1969. Apollo landed on the moon, but this girl shows no interest in it. Instead, she relentlessly searches through old bookstores for Nietzsche's phantom book.

[From [url=https://x.com/ErogeAreAlive/status/2046528182438756694]Visual Novel News[/url]]
